description: Additional strict-mode unset-variable failures: an unset env placeholder wrapped in literal prefix/suffix text, an unset variable reached through a single file include, an unset variable reached through a two-level include chain, and an unset variable located inside a list value of the section. Each enables strict mode and prints 'error=env_not_set' with the offending variable name.

input.config:
common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
wrapped:
  url: "https://{{ env='MISSING_HOST' }}/path"
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2

common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
via_include:
  data: "{{ file='inc.yaml' }}"
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2

common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
deep_chain:
  data: "{{ file='level1.yaml' }}"
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2
